releases.notes:
Two months since 1.2.0. Was there a good reason for the wait? Nope, just plain laziness. But I finally got around to it, and it was worth it.

### New Stuff

* In-Game Config Screen (`ModConfigScreen`). Too many slimeballs? Not enough TNT? Now you can tell the mod exactly how chaotic you want your server to be. Everything is split into 6 neat categories.
* Tweak (Almost) Everything. Party size, hand-over and pull reach, cooldowns for potatoes, slimeballs and TNT, boss health scaling and its cap, which items can go on your head (banners, feathers, decorative blocks, candle grouping up to 4), the typing indicator, nickname color rewards and chat emojis. Every mechanic also gets an on/off switch, so you can turn off whatever annoys your friends the most.
* Health Sharing. Sacrifice a bit of your own health to heal a teammate. Amount and cooldown are configurable. Yes, this is what real friendship looks like.
* Full config translations in English, Russian and Ukrainian.

### Changed

* `/party` now respects the "Enable Party System" option. If the party system is disabled, the command tells you so.
* Values that used to be hardcoded (max party size, throw cooldowns, interaction reach) now come from the config.

### Technical & Boring (But Important) Stuff

* Config Storage (`ModConfig`): Settings are saved to `config/donidins_fun_with_friends.json`. Note that gameplay logic runs on the server, so the server's config is the one that counts.
* New Dependency: The config screen is built with YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) 3.8.2 or newer, and it is now required. Don't forget to install it!
* Architectural Refactoring: `ModEntities` moved from the `entity` package to `init`, next to the other registries.

releases.notes:
Great news! Version 1.2.0 was made in an absolute hurry — at some point I realized the project wasn't heading where I wanted it to go. So I took a step back and rewrote half of the mod's codebase to make playing it much more enjoyable, responsive, and fun.

***

### New Stuff
* **Throwing Slimeballs at people (`SlimeballEntity`).** Because TNT was too destructive and Poisonous Potatoes were too toxic. Slow down your friends with a fast-flying lump of green goo right to the face!
* **Brand New Party System (`/party`).** You can now officially form groups! Invite your friends, track team statuses, and coordinate your stupid antics together. 
* **Tab-List Nickname Customization.** Unlocked a fancy new nickname color? It now shows up directly in the player list (Tab) so everyone on the server can admire your achievements.
* **15 Co-op Advancements Total.** Overhauled the entire progression system! We reworked 1 old advancement and added 10 brand-new ones. Complete teamwork tasks, save friends from cliffs, or betray them for shiny rewards.
* **Overhauled Co-op System.** Completely restructured player-to-player interaction mechanics to feel punchier, smoother, and way more responsive.

### Technical & Boring (But Important) Stuff
* **Smart Server Optimization (`ServerPlayerOptimizationHandler`):** Heavy co-op & party distance checks are now throttled to run every 10 ticks instead of melting the CPU every single tick. 
* **Hat System Caching (`ServerCacheManager`):** Hat-checking logic now uses thread-safe ConcurrentHashMap lookups, eliminating lag spikes when players rapidly test random blocks on their heads.
* **Architectural Refactoring:** Split huge, bloated monolithic classes into neat, modular event handlers. The codebase is now squeaky clean!
* **Thread Safety & Memory Fixes:** Fixed client-side rendering crashes during typing states and eliminated redundant array allocations in advancement tracking.

releases.notes:
### New Stuff
* **A magical new nickname color!** Unlock **Blue Magic** by enchanting an item (unlocked via "Enchanter"). Time to make your name glow like a max-level Enchanting Table!

### Technical & Boring (But Important) Stuff
* **Massive performance & networking fixes:**
  * _Huge shoutout to **dima_dencep** for catching several sneaky networking and optimization bugs!_
  * **Optimized packet syncing:** Typing indicators and nickname updates now only broadcast to players tracking you instead of clogging up the entire server network.
  * **Thread safety:** Made client-side typing states completely thread-safe to prevent rare crashes during rendering.
  * **Memory optimization:** Fixed redundant array allocations when checking for advancement unlocks.
  * Made network payloads optional so players without the mod can join servers more smoothly.

### New Stuff
* **Wear stuff on your head.** (Shift + Right-click.) Because why wouldn't you want to wear a Sea Pickle? You can wear glass, ice, flowers, or even stack up to 4 candles on your skull to become a walking chandelier.
* **Throw TNT at your friends.** (Shift + Right-click.) Just like the Poisonous Potato, but much, much worse. Once again, we are not responsible for broken friendships or cratered bases.
* **New colorful nicknames.** Unlock **Diamond Blue** and **Honey Yellow** by completing advancements. Flex on your friends who are still stuck with basic white.

* **Updated NeoForge.** The version has been bumped up to `21.1.248`.
